plane.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: original isolated transparent vehicle sprite for a top-down 2D 16-bit fantasy/technology adventure RPG. Style must match richly detailed chibi pixel-art heroes, shaded rustic island cottages, and futuristic steel/copper laboratories with cyan windows and brass trim. Polished SNES-era pixel art with crisp deliberately clustered pixels, dark readable silhouette outlines, dimensional multi-tone shading, highlights from upper left. NOT vector art, not minimalist block art, NOT a photorealistic 3D render. Genuine alpha transparency all around, no background, no ground, no platform, no shadow, no text, no logos, no people. One entire vehicle centered with comfortable transparent padding, all extremities visible. ONE small adventurous single-propeller aeroplane, facing RIGHT in a three-quarter slightly top-down side view suitable for an overhead RPG map. Horizontal wide silhouette, width-to-height approximately 1.7 including visible wings. Cream and steel fuselage, deep navy structural details, warm brass and copper trim, cyan glass cockpit, single propeller at the far right nose, tail fin at left, two low landing wheels. Both stubby wings visible in perspective, detailed rivets and panel shading, welcoming fantasy exploration craft. Propeller shown as a short readable vertical metal blade; no motion blur. It must read unmistakably as a propeller airplane, with an especially clear nose/right orientation. Compact silhouette with no long antennae.
